::: {#cor-map-penalized}
#### The MAP estimate minimizes the negative log-likelihood plus a penalty

The [MAP estimate](#def-map) satisfies

$$
\hth_{\text{MAP}}
= \argmin_\theta \paren{-\logf{\p(\vy \mid \theta)} - \logf{\p(\theta)}}.
$$ {#eq-map-penalized}

The first term is the negative log-likelihood.
The second term, $-\logf{\p(\theta)}$, is the penalty that the prior adds.
:::

::: proof
By @cor-bayes-proportional,
$\p(\theta \mid \vy) \propto \p(\vy \mid \theta)\, \p(\theta)$,
and a positive constant does not change where a function is maximized.
The logarithm is an increasing function,
so it does not change where a positive function is maximized either.
Therefore

$$
\argmax_\theta \p(\theta \mid \vy)
= \argmax_\theta \paren{\logf{\p(\vy \mid \theta)} + \logf{\p(\theta)}}.
$$

Maximizing a function is the same as minimizing its negative.
:::
